title: whatsapp_inbox._quota.set
description: The monthly inbound allowance billing granted this hub for the WhatsApp channel. Written ONLY by the runtime's Cloud-facing sync (whatsapp_inbox#37): the command is internal, so no screen, API key or assistant can reach it.

monthly_limit.description: Inbound messages per calendar month the plan allows. 0 = no cap (unmetered plan, or a hub billing has not spoken about yet).
